This is not evidence that Q2_K is universally harmful, but it is not a scorer-created false negative for this frozen operational panel.

Thus the all-gates physical-qualification conjunction is genuinely falsified at this exact 0.8B model, codec and runtime even if the separate answer-accuracy effect is treated as inconclusive.

The favorable VRAM and throughput gates do not rescue qualification and must not be presented as usable-serving evidence without the failed semantic gates: Q2_K generates the full cap in all 32 rows and low-entropy looping can confound an application-level speed interpretation. Rejection is bounded to the frozen Q2_K artifact, 32-prompt panel and thresholds; it makes no IQ2_XXS, 27B/35B, production, other-codec or general low-bit claim.
